criteria.evidence: Benefit hypothesis (who it serves, what we believe, how we will know), Boundary with In/Out/Never lines, seven Guiding rules, four Functionalities, and an Agent intent (ICE) block are all present and substantive.

"Never: send a reminder to a customer whose consent is missing, withdrawn or unknown. Unknown counts as no, because a wrong guess is exactly the failure this capability exists to prevent."; "Out: finding abandoned carts ... Seeing today's abandoned carts (abandoned-carts-today) owns that"

Every section is a list of discrete bullets, one point each ("- One reminder per cart, ever. A second click ... shows 'already reminded' with the date"); the ICE block uses Goal / Limit / Fails if pairs.

Domain: "Reminding customers about an abandoned cart (abandoned-cart-reminders) — lets an owner remind the customer ... in one click." Capability adds the 7-day per-customer limit, one-per-cart rule, link-restores-same-cart, reason shown on block, the record of every attempt, and four named functionalities.

"if an owner can remind that customer with a single click — and the reminder brings the customer back into the same cart — then some of those carts end as finished orders" plus Boundary naming the neighbouring capabilities and the notifications side as owners of what is out.
